name: Investor quote card
purpose: A tinted, full-bleed quote tile in the horizontally-scrolling 'wall of love'. The tint is the investor's own brand color and the text flips light/dark against it.

quote.note: Rendered into a fixed 96px box with -webkit-line-clamp 4 (5 on mobile), so overlong quotes are visually truncated rather than growing the card.

onLightTint.note: true when the tint is dark and the text must be white

wide.note: true = a 560px 'fund' card, false = a 360px 'angel' card

assetPolicy: The logo mark is a GENERIC placeholder glyph (a circle + plus), deliberately NOT the investor's real logo. See assets/asset-roles.json role `decor.logo-placeholder`. A generated page must not substitute a real firm's mark.
